﻿THE CLIP SHIP  ·  LIVE PERFORMANCE BRIEF
Mumford & Sons  ×  Chris Stapleton
Live performance seeding  ·  TikTok · Instagram Reels · YouTube Shorts  ·  Music and theme pages only
Clip the live performance of Mumford & Sons and Chris Stapleton from the approved folder. Every clip should show that this crossover sounds even better live.
QUICK FACTS
Artists
	Mumford & Sons  ·  with Chris Stapleton
	Footage
	Approved folder only  ·  HERE 
	Platforms
	TikTok  ·  Instagram Reels  ·  YouTube Shorts
	Hashtags
	#mumfordandsons  #chrisstapleton  #cmas  #performance
	Sound
	No sound required  ·  keep the live audio
	Length
	8 seconds minimum
	Audience
	Tier 1 majority, Tier 2 accepted  ·  English only
	Approval
	Submit video analytics after 2,000 views
	Max clipper payout
	30% of budget
	

READ THIS FIRST
Keep the live performance audio. The performance is the point, so don’t cover it with music.
	

ABOUT THE ARTISTS
Mumford & Sons are the London folk rock band behind “I Will Wait” and “The Cave”. They made their CMA Awards debut joined by Chris Stapleton, the Kentucky country and soul singer, after the two teamed up on the song “Here”. A British band on country music’s biggest stage, with one of Nashville’s strongest voices beside them.
CONTENT ANGLES
1  ·  BRITISH INVASION OF NASHVILLE
A London band walking onto country music’s biggest night and owning the room.
2  ·  EVEN BETTER LIVE
The crossover at full power: the harmonies, the banjo, Chris’s voice, the crowd reacting, the two acts locking in.
SOUND
✔  Keep the original live audio from the clip.
✖  No added music and no trending audio. Nothing on top of the performance.
WHAT TO DO
1. Download the performance from the approved folder.
2. Cut a clip at least 8 seconds long. Open on the strongest musical moment.
3. Add on screen text from the bank below, or write your own in the same voice.
4. Keep the live audio. No added music.
5. Post from your music or theme page with #mumfordandsons #chrisstapleton #cmas #performance.
6. Post once per platform. Once you pass 2,000 views, submit your video analytics.
ON SCREEN TEXT   REQUIRED
Every clip needs text. Lowercase, short, one idea per line. Use these or write your own in the same voice.
ANGLE
	EXAMPLE LINES
	British invasion of Nashville
	The british invasion of nashville was not on my 2026 bingo card 😭
Mumford & sons at the CMAS. i repeat. mumford & sons at the CMAS
Banjos from london meet nashville and it just works
Nashville said come on in and they did NOT miss
The fellas from across the pond landed with a splash! 
	Even better live
	This collab sounds even better live
Chris stapleton and mumford on one stage is unfair to everyone else
The way their voices blend live 😭
They did NOT have to go this hard on their CMAS debut
I’m officially naming the Marcus Mumford & Chris Stapleton duo, Mapleton ☠️
	

CAPTIONS & TAGGING
✔  Use #mumfordandsons #chrisstapleton #cmas #performance on every post.
✔  Name both artists in the caption so people can find them.
BRAND SAFETY   REQUIRED
✖  Nothing negative about Mumford & Sons, Chris Stapleton or anyone in the clip.
✖  No mocking accents or the British versus country angle in a mean way. Keep it a celebration.
✖  No gossip and no misleading text.
POST REQUIREMENTS   REQUIRED
POST SPECS
✔  At least 8 seconds long
✔  Footage from the approved folder only
✔  Live audio kept, no added music
✔  On screen text on every clip
✔  All 4 hashtags in the caption
✔  Posted from a music or theme page
✔  Likes and comments ON
✔  Posted once per platform

THE RULES
✔  YOU MUST
	✖  YOU WON’T GET PAID IF
	Use footage from the approved folder only
	You add music or trending audio
	Keep the live audio
	You post from a page that isn’t a music or theme page
	Put on screen text on every clip
	There is no on screen text
	Use all 4 hashtags
	The clip is low effort or under 8 seconds
	Post from a music or theme page
	You steal someone else's clip, this is an instant ban
	Keep likes and comments ON
	You spam post, use story boosts, paid boosts or collab posts
	Post each clip once per platform
	You use AI generated covers
	

	The content is NSFW, sexual, aggressive, weird, mean or rude
	

HOW TO GET APPROVED   REQUIRED
1. Wait until your video passes 2,000 views.
2. Screen record your video analytics: watch time, all view graphs, and locations.
3. Send the recording to the analytics submission form channel.


⚠ Only submit if you meet the requirements.
Account level analytics are rejected every time. We need the analytics of the single video.
